tse_present: Following the Timestream Entanglement, the heroes of the Present timeline assembled to face the crisis but not all survived. Amongst the casualties was Captain America.
cap_1:
Captain America stays frozen for a century before being found and captured by Alchemax in the year 2099. He's then rescued by Black Widow.

Together they escaped the lab but soon after part ways.

At some point Captain America fights Doom 2099's bots.
cap_2:
With the help of Wolverine, Steve finds the embassy of Wakanda, whose king he befriended during World War II. The embassy however had been abandoned for years.

Wolverine then activated a Kimoyo bead and a strange portal opened. This lead Steve to the Intergalactic Empire of Wakanda where he was welcomed by T'Challa and Shuri, the latter offering him a new shield.

Black Panther tasks Captain America to find heroes from across the timelines and bring them to their side.
hydra_0:
The Timestream Entanglement disrupted the timelines at Earth's two poles resulting in the appearance of Chronovium in the South Pole.

Hydra's Hell Heaven base on Charteris Mount which was built on top of a much older set of ruins is reawaken as Hydra prepares a Doomsday plan.

At the lowest section of the base they began mining Chronovium using it to siphon life force from Hive creatures, which is then used to create their Super-Soldiers.

On the sublevels they're also trying to open a portal to Maveth, the location where their otherworldly deity, the Hive, resides, believing it to be the key to unlocking their history and ushering a new era where Hydra reigns supreme.
hydra_1:
The Winter Soldier is sent to infiltrate and gather intel about Hydra activity inside Charteris Mount. He tried to destroy the Hive chamber but was overwhelmed by Hydra soldiers who tore off his cybernetic arm.

He was taken to the base's Super-Soldier Lab where Hydra turned his arm into squid-like appendages and he was locked up in a glass tank. He would later be taken by the Occult Ops as Hydra planned to use him a conduit to access Maveth. At some point the Hydra Priests sang an hymn around him before returning him to the lab.
hydra_2:
Three days after the Winter Soldier infiltrated the base, in the same week Captain America died, Agent 13 flies Hawkeye to Rock Island, giving him the mission of rescuing Bucky.

He navigates his way inside and reaches the Super-Soldier Lab, there he finds Bucky inside a tank labeled 'CANARY'. He fights a Hydra Super-Soldier, who unintentionally frees Bucky, the latter uses his tentacles to defeat the Super-Soldier.
hydra_3:
Hawkeye and the Winter Soldier move to the lower levels, to the Hive chamber, onto an altar near a portal radiating ancient energy with a creature trying to come through. Bucky extended his tentacles into carvings on the altar. The creature emerging from the portal wrapped its tentacles around him and it was as if a circuit had been completed and the Winter Soldier was the conduit.

Hawkeye cut Bucky's tentacles, releasing a shockwave of energy. The chamber’s walls and pillars begging to topple. Then the portal surged with energy and the creature retreated back to the other side.
hydra_4:
Wakanda manages to hijack and redirect Hydra's portal energy signature to open a gateway of their own, leading Captain America to the depths of the Charteris Base.

As the area begun collapsing, he shows up through the portal to save the duo, taking them to Wakanda where they're greeted by  Black Panther and Shuri. The latter offers Bucky a new arm.
hydra_5:
The Hive's influence starts taking over the Winter Soldier. Both his eyes and the ones of a statue of Bast nearby begin glowing deep red.

Tentacles start rapidly growing where Bucky's new arm was, intertwined with the technology of the limb.

Clint leaves in a Wakandan ship to warn T'Challa and Shuri, while Steve stays fighting Bucky.

Clint returns with Shuri who comes up with a plan to help Bucky. Clint then shoots an arrow at him with a Kimoyo bead which rebooted his arm allowing him to return to normal.
iew_1:
After the Timestream Entanglement, the spirit realm of Djalia began merging with Birnin T'Challa in the physical world. Bast's spirit is ensnared within Chrono-Vibranium.

Chrono-Vibranium began appearing in the Intergalactic Empire of Wakanda, this being Chronovium containing power drawn from their Vibranium Star. Shuri begins researching this and while helping Reed Richards and Tony Stark with the Timestream Reintegration Device.


At some point both Dooms try to enlist Black Panther in their battles.
iew_1_2: Unbeknownst to Shuri and T'Challa, the Orisha, including Bast, are corrupted by Knull.
iew_2:
K'Liluna warns T'Challa of a darkness to come, one that had already tainted the Orisha. This plants a seed of doubt inside him, but he does not share this information with his sister.

Bast speaks to Shuri in her dreams and her suspicions that the goddess had been corrupted start emerging. She keeps this to herself and keeps investigating the Timestream Entanglement and Chrono-Vibranium.
iew_3:
In the Hall of Djalia, T'Challa tries to commune with the Orisha, including Bast, but to no avail as the gods had been silent for some time.

Shuri tells T'Challa that she's been helping Reed Richards and Tony Stark on their Timestream Reintegration Device. She asks him to give them some of their Chrono-Vibranium but he refuses.

On his way to the Hall of Djalia, T'Challa begins hearing Bast's voice. He senses a corruption in her and she tells him of another King in Black. As this happens, tendrils of ebony energy started ensnaring the empire.
iew_4:
After the incident with Bucky, Shuri told T'Challa how she believed Bast had been corrupted. 

T'Challa ventured into Djalia seeking answers. There he found the Great Veldt empty.

After wondering for some time, he blindfolded himself and called out to Bast.

Bast speaks to him, telling him to swear his allegiance to her, in return she would give him unlimited power.

In his mind he saw a Heart-Shaped Herb burning a fiery crimson, confirming his suspicions.

He became set on freeing his goddess from this corruption.
klyntar_adam_1: When the Timestream Entanglement happened, Adam shielded himself within a cocoon.
klyntar_adam_2: As Adam drifted through the cosmos, he found himself near Yggsgard. He heard Odin's voice in his head, warning him of a darkness to come, one that crept into his realm and his dreams. As he drifted away, he left a small fraction of his soul energy behind with Odin.
klyntar_adam_3: As he approached the Intergalactic Empire of Wakanda, he heard Bast. She warned him of a feast to come and Adam could sense she had been corrupted.
klyntar_adam_4:
The Celestial tells Adam that the being who slain it had awakened, and that someone needed to stop him. As Adam searched in the Celestial's mind for this being, it screamed a final warning, telling Adam the being had found him.

The Celestial's psionic scream sent Venom tumbling towards Klyntar as he watched the All-Black awaken and burry itself deeper into the Celestial.

After the scream, Knull himself invaded Adam's mind, dragging him towards the King of Black.

But suddenly, the Phoenix Force blasted through, sending Adam's cocoon towards Klyntar.
klyntar_gog_1: Shuri tasks the Guardians of the Galaxy to investigate the source of a dark energy that flared up at the edge of the known universe shortly after Bast spoke to her in her sleep.
klyntar_gog_2:
Shuri looses connection to the Guardians as they approach Klyntar. The Milano is shot down and disabled by a mysterious force and Star-Lord, Groot and Rocket are stranded in Klyntar.

They crash onto the ruins of the Agents of the Cosmos, in a huge ship graveyard. The crash leaving behind a fiery path.

After Rocket and Quill argued, Groot leaves and soon after so does Rocket.
klyntar_gog_3:
Rocket goes looking for parts to repair the ship but is attacked by symbiotes. He runs to a building and uses a miniature gravity well that annihilates some of the creatures and jams the building's door with debris.

While looting the building he's attack by its defensive system turrets which was then destroyed by a symbiote.

Rocket manages to hunk himself in a room using a energy barrier projector some turrets. Inside the room he figures out how to repair the Milano with the tech he found.
klyntar_gog_4:
Groot is distracted by voices coming from the jungle surround the graveyard. He communes with the local faun who warn him to stay away. He learns that the plants have no concept of kindness, trust or friendship.

Meanwhile Star-Lord creates a firebreak behind the ship and starts fighting off the symbiotes. 

The fire caused by the crash spread to another ship causing an explosion in the graveyard and the fire to spread to the jungle and buildings.

Most symbiotes leave the ship alone and take off toward the fire.
klyntar_gog_5:
Groot grows roots and uses them to lifts the soil to suffocating the fire near the jungle and saving the plants.

Of the plants warns him that Rocket is in danger and he charged to find him. He punches through the walls of the building and fights symbiotes while trying to get to Rocket. His new plant friends show up and take down the symbiotes.

Rocket powers down the energy barrier projection and tasks Groot to carry its frame to the ship, as they had to find Quill and make sure he was safe.
klyntar_gog_6:
Quill spends a couple hours fixing the ship before Rocket and Groot show up. 

Quill explains his plan to them which is to use their Nega-Energy Replicator to quantum swap the ship with the corpse of dead celestial above the planet. Rocket and Groot just so happened to have picked up what they needed to survive this switcheroo, the energy barrier projection.

They set everything up and are transported to the Negative Zone alongside the Celestial.
klyntar_gog_7:
While drifting near its corpse, Adam's presence awakens the Celestial's conciseness. The Milano warns that the Celestial is still alive and the trio see it start twitching and soon after shake violently.

On its chest, they spot Venom and Adam's cocoon so Quill decides to take the ship back to Klyntar.

Rocket storms off the ship alongside Groot, as Quill looks up at the corpse and sees Adam's light shining on.
klyntar_knull_1:
Following the Timestream Entanglement, Knull is stirred from his imprisoned slumber by chronal energies. He awakens as a living time crystal, gradually regaining his power and asserting control over the symbiote cluster on Klyntar.

The same chronal energies can be found in the Celestial Codex and Knull's trapped essence seeks to rejoin with it.

Knull taps into Chronovium to spread his corruption across the gods and free himself from Klyntar.
klyntar_venom_1: When Venom's reality collapsed, the Klyntar hivemind overloaded Eddie's brain and left them without knowing where they had come from.
klyntar_venom_2:
At some point, Magik locks Venom up in a cage in a nether realm but they manage to free themselves. Soon after they join her in her fight against the gods.

While chatting with Magik, Venom suddenly receive a message from the Hivemind asking them to go to Klyntar and slay Knull.

Magik tells him to get a sword and Venom reminisces about the legends of the All-Black, the Necrosword, how it was lost after Knull slayed a Celestial with it.

Venom touched Magik, giving her the knowledge of where they needed to go. She opened a interdimensional portal and Venom stepped through.

They found themselves on the corpse of the Celestial and soon after found the All-Black. Its darkness had spread across the surface of the Celestial, making it hard to pull it out, though Venom kept trying.
klyntar_venom_3:
The symbiotes helped Venom land safely onto the planet. Meanwhile Adam's cocoon crashed onto its surface and was about to be swallowed by a sea of hungry symbiotes.

To save Adam, Venom tore through the cocoon. After emerging from it, both quickly realized they shared a common goal, to stop Knull.
klyntar_venom_4: The Guardians want to use Knull's essence to burrow into the world before he awakens. Meanwhile Venom seeks to consume the essence itself and become the new King in Black.
